description: If a strictly increasing sequence a of natural numbers satisfies x greater than a(i) for every x in A(i), then the intersection of all A(i) is empty.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PartitionRelations.tails_intersection_empty (a : ℕ → ℕ) (ha : StrictMono a) (A : ℕ → Set ℕ)
  (hA : ∀ (i x : ℕ), x ∈ A i → a i < x) : ⋂ i, A i = ∅
